answer: Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 31 aliases, and each one needs its own funded voyage account. Deposits are visible in dune, and karst reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 24% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. A farm of 1687 identities would post 4297 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
